suspect:callum_dray: Callum Dray checked his watch before answering any question. His white coat was pressed but the pen in his pocket had leaked.
event:dosage_interaction: Two medications given within the same hour produced a cardiac arrest. Each drug alone was within prescribed limits.
motive:negligence_testimony: Harold Stroud was scheduled to testify at a negligence hearing the following Monday. His statement named Callum Dray directly.
suspect:nurse_aldworth: Nurse Aldworth administered the evening round at nine. Her hands trembled when she signed the medication chart.
suspect:dr_parris: Dr Parris covered the night shift and checked the ward at midnight. His stethoscope was still around his neck at breakfast.
suspect:owen_stroud: Owen Stroud visited his uncle at seven and stayed for forty minutes. He asked the duty nurse about the prognosis twice.
suspect:records_clerk: The records clerk filed the complaint paperwork three days before the death. Her badge was unsigned on the night in question.
suspect:pharmacist_lin: Pharmacist Lin dispensed both medications from the same tray. Her inventory count at shift end was two vials short.
suspect:solicitor_pike: Solicitor Pike represented the Stroud family in the negligence case. He visited the clinic twice in the week before the death.
location:briar_clinic: Briar Clinic occupies a converted Victorian house on a quiet road. The night entrance is through a side door with a keycard lock.
location:private_ward: The private ward holds four beds separated by curtains. Bed three faces the window and the call button is on the left rail.
location:dispensary: The dispensary is behind a coded door at the end of the staff corridor. Two shelves hold cardiac medications in amber bottles.
location:staff_corridor: The staff corridor runs from the dispensary to the ward without passing reception. The lights dim automatically after ten.
location:records_office: The records office is locked after six but the keycard system logs all entries. The filing cabinet nearest the door holds active complaints.
location:consulting_room: Dray's consulting room contains a desk, two chairs, and a cabinet of clinical notes. The blinds were drawn on the night in question.
location:car_park: The car park holds twelve spaces behind the clinic. Dray's car was recorded entering at 22:14 and not leaving until 05:30.
location:waiting_room: The waiting room smells of disinfectant and old magazines. Owen Stroud signed the visitor log at 19:02.
object:medication_chart: The medication chart for bed three shows two entries at 21:00. Both dosages are individually within normal range.
object:syringe_tray: The syringe tray from the evening round holds two used syringes. One contains trace residue of a beta blocker.
object:drug_ledger: The dispensary ledger records all withdrawals by name and time. Dray's signature appears at 20:48, twelve minutes before the round.
object:interaction_manual: The drug interaction manual lies open on the dispensary shelf. The page for cardiac combinations is dog-eared and marked in pencil.
object:visitor_log: The visitor log shows Owen Stroud arriving at 19:02 and leaving at 19:41. No other visitors were recorded that evening.
object:autopsy_report: The autopsy found lethal levels of two drugs whose combined effect depresses cardiac rhythm. Individually, each was within safe limits.
object:prescription_carbon: The carbon copy of the prescription shows both drugs ordered on the same form. The handwriting matches Dray's clinical notes.
object:insurance_form: An insurance claim form sits in Owen Stroud's briefcase, partially completed. The beneficiary section lists Owen as sole recipient.
object:corridor_badge: A staff corridor badge was found on the waiting room floor. The name field is blank and the magnetic strip is deactivated.
object:ward_keycard: The ward keycard log shows three entries between 20:30 and 22:00. One entry has no matching staff assignment.
object:clinical_notes: Dray's clinical notes for Harold Stroud show a revised dosage recommendation dated two days before the death. The original page is missing.
object:lab_slip: A laboratory slip requesting cardiac enzyme levels was filed at 20:15. The results were never collected.
object:complaint_filing: The negligence complaint names Dray as the attending physician during a prior incident. The hearing date is circled in red.
emotion:professional_calm: His voice did not change when the death was confirmed. He asked for the chart and read it without sitting down.
emotion:shaking_hands: Her hands shook when she held the chart for the inspector. She set it on the desk rather than hand it across.
emotion:clipped_answers: Every response was one sentence or fewer. He did not volunteer any detail beyond what was directly asked.
emotion:avoided_ward: Dr Parris did not enter the private ward after the body was removed. He stood in the corridor and looked at the floor.
emotion:rehearsed_grief: Owen Stroud's eulogy was word-perfect and delivered without pause. He had not been told the cause of death.
emotion:rigid_composure: She answered each question with the same even tone. Her eyes moved to the dispensary door and back.
modifier:dosage_doubled: The combined effect of both drugs doubled the suppression of cardiac rhythm. Any physician trained in cardiology would know this.
modifier:chart_amended: The medication chart shows a correction in different ink. The original dosage has been overwritten with a lower figure.
modifier:badge_unsigned: The corridor badge found in the waiting room has no name or photograph. The magnetic strip was never activated.
modifier:insulin_combined: The second drug was an insulin analogue given for blood sugar management. Its cardiac side effects are listed on page forty-seven of the manual.
modifier:corridor_dim: The staff corridor lights dim to half brightness after ten. The motion sensor near the dispensary door was offline.
modifier:lock_overridden: The ward door lock was overridden by a master keycard at 20:51. The master card is assigned to senior physicians only.
modifier:handwriting_match: The revised clinical notes match Dray's handwriting in slope and pressure. The ink is from a different pen than the rest of the file.
modifier:fresh_notation: A pencil notation in the drug interaction manual was made recently. The graphite has not yet dulled.
modifier:vial_count_short: The dispensary inventory at shift end was two vials short of the morning count. No breakage was reported.
modifier:filing_date_wrong: The complaint filing is dated three days before the death. The postmark on the envelope shows it arrived five days earlier.
action:chart_signed: The medication chart was signed by Nurse Aldworth at 21:00 and countersigned by Dray at 21:03. Both signatures are in the same ink.
action:dispensary_visited: The dispensary keycard log shows Dray entered at 20:48 and exited at 20:56. The standard withdrawal takes under two minutes.
action:records_accessed: The records office keycard shows an entry at 23:10 from a master card. No staff member was scheduled to access records after hours.
action:injection_given: Two injections were administered during the evening medication round. The second was given eleven minutes after the first.
action:alarm_delayed: The cardiac alarm sounded at 05:12 but the ward orderly found the body already cold. The alarm delay suggests it was silenced and re-armed.
action:notes_rewritten: The clinical notes for Harold Stroud were rewritten on new paper and re-filed. The original notes have not been found.
action:family_visited: Owen Stroud visited his uncle three times in the week before the death. Each visit lasted under forty-five minutes.
action:complaint_filed: The negligence complaint was filed by Solicitor Pike on behalf of Harold Stroud. It referenced a prior surgical error by Dray.
action:lab_ordered: A laboratory panel was ordered for Harold Stroud at 20:15. The order slip bears Dray's initials.
time:attended_observation: The attended observation hour runs from 21:00 to 22:00. During this period a nurse checks vitals every fifteen minutes.
time:night_round: The night round begins at midnight and covers all four beds. Dr Parris recorded normal readings at 00:15.
time:shift_handover: The shift handover occurs at 06:00. Nurse Aldworth's notes from the previous shift were incomplete.
time:dawn_alarm: The cardiac alarm triggered at 05:12. The responding orderly found the patient unresponsive and cold to the touch.
time:hearing_scheduled: The negligence hearing was scheduled for Monday the fourteenth. Harold Stroud was the sole complainant witness.
motive:malpractice_cover: If Stroud testified, Dray's surgical error from the previous year would become public record. His licence review was already pending.
motive:insurance_claim: Owen Stroud stood to receive a substantial insurance payout upon his uncle's death. The policy had been updated six months earlier.
motive:career_ruin: A successful negligence ruling would end Dray's career in private practice. No clinic would insure a physician with a public finding.
motive:family_grudge: Owen Stroud had quarrelled with his uncle over the estate. Harold had threatened to change the insurance beneficiary.
motive:prior_complaint: A prior complaint against Dray had been settled privately two years earlier. The terms included a non-disclosure clause.
witness:night_porter: The night porter saw Dray's car enter the car park at 22:14. He did not see anyone else arrive after that.
witness:ward_orderly: The ward orderly found Harold Stroud unresponsive at 05:12. He described the body as cold and the bedside glass as untouched.
witness:lab_assistant: The lab assistant received the enzyme order at 20:15 but the sample never arrived. She filed the slip in the incomplete tray.
witness:duty_nurse: The duty nurse recorded normal vitals at 21:15 and 21:30. She did not check again until the alarm sounded.
witness:ambulance_driver: The ambulance was called at 05:18 and arrived at 05:31. The driver noted that the clinic front door was already propped open.
event:harold_stroud_discovered: Harold Stroud was found unresponsive in bed three of the private ward. The cardiac monitor had been silenced and the IV line was disconnected.
event:medication_round: The evening medication round was completed at 21:11. Two injections were logged for bed three, both within prescribed parameters.
